jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE production texture master for an RPG Maker MV orthogonal top-down dungeon, Stonekeep in The Elder Scrolls Arena. References supplied: image1 original screenshot R03 for pale wall masonry color/proportions ONLY (ignore perspective, red carpet, glyphs and furnishings); image2 original CASA.SET#0 decoded consultation for the same material. Create a seamless square texture filling entire canvas: pale cold gray stone masonry in horizontal running-bond courses, rectangular blocks with dark thin recessed joints, restrained white worn facets, slightly irregular chiseled edges. Preserve the distinctive pale masonry of Arena, refined dark fantasy digital painting, legible at 48px, not generic brown medieval stones, not pixel art. Completely FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC material elevation usable for the two-tile vertical wall face in a top-down 2D game: parallel horizontal and vertical lines, NO camera convergence, NO diagonal/isometric edges. Aim four courses across a 96px-high game wall. Even diffuse upper-left light, NO baked vignette, no spotlights, no cast shadows across tile edges. Tile left/right AND top/bottom seamlessly. No frame, labels, grid overlay, furniture, doors, heraldry, carpet, characters, floor, water or scenery. This is an opaque material sample, not an illustration of a room.
